run_evaluation: run evaluation episodes for trained Minimax agents on specified environments using python -m minimax.evaluate
run_evaluation_with_prefix: run evaluation across all experiments matching an xpid_prefix pattern and aggregate results
run_rendered_evaluation: run evaluation with render_mode enabled to visualize agent episodes in the environment
run_multi_agent_evaluation: run evaluation for specific agent indices using --agent_idxs to select individual students
run_save_results: run evaluation and save aggregated stats to a CSV file using --results_fname
